name.zh: 仰卧直腿大分腿慢开合

purpose.zh: 仰卧把直腿向两侧打开再合拢，练大腿内侧的控制和髋的开度，为分腿类动作打底
purpose.en: Lying on your back, open your straight legs wide to the sides and close them. Trains inner-thigh control and hip opening for straddle moves.

text.zh: 腿伸直，两腿匀速向两侧打开再合拢
text.en: Legs straight, open wide and close evenly

text.zh: 仰卧，手臂放在身体两侧掌心贴垫，双腿伸直举到竖直。
text.en: Lie on your back, arms by your sides, palms down, legs straight up.

text.zh: 膝盖一直伸直，两条腿同时打开，开到大腿内侧有拉伸感。
text.en: Knees stay straight; both legs open together until the inner thighs stretch.

text.zh: 下背和骨盆贴住垫子，不左右晃。
text.en: Lower back and pelvis stay on the mat, no rocking.

commonErrors.zh: 两条腿一快一慢、不对称
commonErrors.en: One leg moving faster or wider than the other.
Arching the lower back off the mat.

cautions.zh: 腿后侧太紧举不到竖直，可以微屈膝或腿放低一点
cautions.en: If tight hamstrings keep your legs from vertical, bend the knees slightly or let the legs tilt lower.

training.source: flare2 r3 2b animation tempo (8 s per rep: 3 s open, 0.5 s wide, 3 s close, 1.5 s together)

flare2.item: Flare2：仰卧直腿大分腿慢开合
flare2.camera: 脚侧斜上方（看得到两腿向两侧打开的幅度和对称）
flare2.doseBrief: 表：慢速开合；草稿 8 次 × 2 组、休 30 秒（待定）
flare2.note: Animation r3 2b: supine, straight legs vertical (hip flexion 88 deg), open evenly to ~40 deg each side (~79 deg between the legs) over 3 s, 0.5 s pause, close over 3 s; pelvis still. 8 s loop = 1 rep, symmetric (no mirror).

reminders.zh: 膝盖伸直，两条腿一起打开
reminders.en: Knees straight, both legs open together

reminders.zh: 下背贴住垫子，骨盆不晃
reminders.en: Lower back on the mat, pelvis still
